official_definition: You can draw two cards. Then, you can summon a Purple "Bannerace"/"God-King" family card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Banner God-Army] or [Banner God-Army: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Banner God-Army]", "give [Banner God-Army]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
